citation: Project owner, Glessner House version 4 reconstruction brief, 29 September 2026: correct intersecting roofs, courtyard and garden-level openings, continuous copper roof at the inner northeast corner, variable-height ashlar courses, and east-wing chimneys. Follow-up 1 October 2026: rebuild west-wing roof, gables and dormer from northwest/west views; carve the north entrance alcove with left-turn steps and door against HABS floor plans. Later 1 October correction: continuous rear ridge, balanced solid south gable and courtyard eave matching the north range.
describes_date: 1904-07-01, with modern surviving fabric supplied as qualitative cross-checks
repository: Owner instruction in the project conversation; concise scope and reference inventory retained in docs/RESEARCH/glessner_house_v4.md.
rights_note: The owner supplied the written reconstruction specification and reference images for this implementation. This clearance covers the owner brief; it does NOT claim a reusable licence for the accompanying third-party photographs or Google Earth screenshots. Visible architectural facts and arrangements inform declared reconstruction; no screenshot pixels, photographic textures or photogrammetric meshes are copied.
access_notes: Read in the project conversation on 2026-09-29. Fourteen supplied reference images were also viewed as qualitative comparisons; HABS supplies measured coordinates. Ten additional images supplied and viewed on 2026-10-01 (210139 through 212524). HABS sheets 2–3 were reread at full resolution from the repository. Read the two current-model views and owner south-gable sketch supplied in the follow-up to PR #243; inventory in docs/RESEARCH/glessner-south-gable/work.md.
note: A production brief, not historical testimony. It authorizes a reconstructed treatment of missing details but does not document their 1904 dimensions. The modern reference views explicitly influence reconstructed arrangements and material boundaries where identified in the dossier; this is acknowledged, not disguised as a HABS measurement.
what_it_supplies: The owner-requested visible omissions to correct in version 4.
Qualitative cross-check that a cross gable, west-wing courtyard windows, garden-level lights and a continuous corner copper roof should not be omitted.
T-1830 owner request and qualitative roof/entrance comparisons; first- and second-floor HABS plans supply dimensional control.
T-1833 owner-directed south-gable and matching courtyard-eave reconstruction, superseding the prior rear hip.
what_it_does_not_supply: A measured survey or a dated 1904 view.
Reusable photographic textures or permission to redistribute third-party reference images.
Exact dimensions, colour, roof patina, plantings, or a pre-1946 date for an otherwise undocumented opening.
